authorization: 用户允许只读冻结24张已有派生标签掩膜，仅用于边界统计；不得读取冻结原图或原标注
boundary_rule: two-sided nearest unequal-known-label interface; pixel-center Chebyshev radius2, no image-frame boundary and no255 boundary; count band-associated errors as estimate, not causal proof
disjoint_count_rule: c(all mismatches within2px label band) first; then a(Field->ridge outside band), b(Field->Road outside band), d(remaining errors outside band); raw a/b totals also reported
bare_soil_rule: No bare-soil ground truth exists; frozen Field errors cannot be uniquely labeled bare-soil; development-only visual examples support interpretation, no spectral/color threshold on frozen images
width_rule: class binary mask equivalent width=2*pixel area/four-neighbor perimeter, native pixel units; includes image clipping, not measured real width
road_rule: saved final Road pixels iff frozen-code W5 argmax==2; infer support activations without re-forwarding or claiming saved W5 probabilities
recommendation_basis: development-only label/geometry review; frozen counts only descriptive, no tuning/calibration/label edit
